import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')
data.columns = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species']

# Map species to numerical values for plotting
species_map = {'setosa': 1, 'versicolor': 2, 'virginica': 3}
data['species'] = data['species'].map(species_map)

# Create a pairplot with seaborn
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', markers=["o", "s", "D"], palette=['green', 'red', 'blue'])

# Set title and labels
plt.title('Iris Dataset Pairplot')
plt.xlabel('Variable')
plt.ylabel('Value')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
